codeReview.summary: The implementation fully satisfies all feature requirements. Three comprehensive unit tests were added to validate subpixel positioning behavior: (1) test_subpixel_bin_comprehensive_fractional_coverage with 17 test cases covering all 4 bins (Zero, One, Two, Three) across boundaries, midpoints, and different integer positions, (2) test_subpixel_bin_text_shares_same_bin verifying all characters in a text string share the same subpixel bin determined at text start, (3) test_subpixel_bin_advance_width_consistency confirming advance width consistency within and across bins. All tests pass (67 katla_ui tests total, including 64 existing). Code follows TDD principles, is well-documented with clear assertions, and validates core subpixel positioning behavior used in the text rendering pipeline.
